decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a low-cost complement to the core flooring business, and after only one year its value is still uncertain, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.
The maintenance oil line supports the surface-treatment offer for oiled floors, costs little to keep listed, and has not yet produced evidence that would justify abandoning it.
Care products for oiled floors build on the established offer with low holding costs, and the early results do not yet resolve the uncertainty about their value.
An underlay with moisture protection is a functional accessory that installers need, so keeping this inexpensive option preserves upside while the firm learns about demand.
The high-density foam underlay may overlap with other underlays and could later be pruned, but one year is too little evidence to abandon it given its low carrying cost.
The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's offer, and the industry is growing, so the firm is likely to commit further rather than abandon it.
